subject.title: Support installing all skills/plugins from a publisher

question: Should ClawHub support publisher-wide installation, and if so should it cover skills, plugins, or both while preserving per-artifact acceptance?
rationale: Current contracts are single-item, repository intent requires explicit acceptance for non-official code plugins, and the related CLI namespace remains unsettled; implementation cannot safely choose these semantics automatically.

options.title: Guarded family-aware install
options.body: Add preview, skill/plugin filters, per-artifact acceptance and compatibility checks, snapshot confirmation, and partial-failure reporting.

options.title: Skills-only bulk install
options.body: Allow publisher-wide skill installation while keeping executable plugin packages individually selected and accepted.

options.title: Discovery without bulk install
options.body: Expose publisher catalog listing in the CLI but retain individual install or download commands for every artifact.

recommendation.title: Guarded family-aware install
recommendation.body: Add preview, skill/plugin filters, per-artifact acceptance and compatibility checks, snapshot confirmation, and partial-failure reporting.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the recent install-path contributor and the collaborator driving both this request and the related CLI taxonomy proposal.
